question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"abundantly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Abundantly'** means in large quantities or amounts. (पर्याप्त से अधिक मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example**:* She watered the plants **abundantly**__ to help them grow faster.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits grammatically and contextually.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

Amla tree is __considered__ to be thousands of years old. It is called aamaleki and dhaatri in Sanskrit. Its botanical name is Emblica Officinalis. The amla tree is a medium __sized__ tree with citrus fruits. It is found almost everywhere in India __except__ for some very high mountainous regions. It is found __**abundantly**__ in Madhya Pradesh. The leaves are very small and have a close ______ (5) ______ to those of Gulmohar. The amla tree has slender branches which grow upwards and surround the trees on all sides.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lavishly**: in a luxurious or extravagant manner. (विलासी या असाधारण तरीके से)
 
• **Profusely**: in large amounts; excessively. (बड़ी मात्रा में; अधिकता से)
 
• **Wholly**: completely; entirely. (पूरी तरह, पूर्णतया; सर्वथा)
